theorems.statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |X ψ| ≤ c * X.mass.toReal) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) k), ∃ ρ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (ρ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (θ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → ∀ (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - exteriorDerivative (θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v) → (∀ (N : ℕ) (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 1 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) → (∀ N k : ℕ, ∃ Ψ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) k →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid N) k, (∀ (γ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), Ψ γ v = γ (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ ∀ γ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) k, covectorEuclideanNorm (Ψ γ) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (S : ∀ m : ℕ, TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (m + 1) → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) m), X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → (∀ (m : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (m + 1)) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin m → Euclid N), (S m ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → (∀ (m : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (m + 1)) (c : ℝ), (∀ y : Euclid (N + 1), covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (m + 1)) y) ≤ c) → ∀ x : Euclid N, covectorEuclideanNorm ((S m ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) m) x) ≤ c) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), Z ω = X (S k ω)) → Z.boundary.mass < ∞
